definitions.explanation: The breathing sound made during sleep.

examples.japanese: いびき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うるさくて→うるさい：00763_urusai⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れない→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧。
examples.english: I can't sleep because the snoring is loud.

examples.japanese: いびき⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦グッズ→グッズ：10800_guzzu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧いびき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きくて→大きい：00335_ookii⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きてしまった→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: My father's snoring was so loud that everyone in the family woke up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れている→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧いびき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なると→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It's said that when you're tired, your snoring gets louder than usual.

notes:
いびき refers to snoring, the breathing sound made during sleep.

WRITING:
Can be written as {鼾|いびき} but hiragana is more common.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- いびき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かく→掻く：09647_kaku⟧: to snore
- いびき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: snoring is loud
- いびき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うるさい→うるさい：00763_urusai⟧: snoring is noisy
- いびき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: snoring won't stop

RELATED WORDS:
- いびき⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧: anti-snoring
- いびき⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: snoring countermeasures
- ⟦{寝息|ねいき}→寝息：16696_neiki⟧: sleeping breath (quiet breathing while asleep)

HEALTH NOTE:
Chronic loud snoring may indicate ⟦{睡眠|すいみん}{時|じ}{無呼吸|むこきゅう}{症候群|しょうこうぐん}→睡眠時無呼吸症候群：noentry⟧ (sleep apnea syndrome), a condition where breathing repeatedly stops during sleep.

ONOMATOPOEIA:
Snoring sounds are often written as ⟦グーグー→ぐーぐー：28098_guuguu⟧ or ⟦ゴーゴー→ゴーゴー：noentry⟧.
